learning_outcomes.text: Understand the inductive process, understanding the main concepts involved in said process.
Know the main supervised learning algorithms for binary and multi-class classification problems, regression, and ordinal classification.
Solve supervised learning applications using an appropriate algorithm depending on the application to be solved and the objective loss function.
Correctly estimate the error committed by a model and know how to statistically compare different algorithms or models.
Understand the formulation and derivation techniques of optimization-based learning algorithms, understanding the concept of regularization.
Use appropriate techniques to process data for a learning problem.
Know the basic aspects related to privacy, ethics, and equality that must be taken into account in data learning processes.

assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, a minimum grade of 4 out of 10 is required for both the practical and theoretical evaluations. If these minimums are met, the final grade is calculated as: ((EP1+EP2)/2 x 0.45) + (ET x 0.4) + (CO x 0.1) + (A x 0.05). Otherwise, the grade will be the minimum of the calculated score and 4. For extraordinary calls, a theoretical exam (ET) and a practical exam (EP) are given, both requiring a minimum grade of 4 out of 10. If both minimums are met, the final grade is (ET x 0.5) + (EP x 0.5), otherwise the grade will be the minimum of the calculated score and 4. Students who achieved a grade of 5 or higher in the theoretical or practical part in the ordinary call can retake only the failed part.
